summary.en: Continuous Galerkin elements with high-order local polynomials and GLL quadrature. A small2D Poisson example compares h/p refinement with the existing P1 FEM; related implementations include Nek5000 and nekRS.

limitations.ja: 滑らかな固定問題だけの結果。要素・求積・代数ソルバーが異なるので、速度・計算量・汎用的優位性の比較ではありません。GLLの対角求積質量は一般の積の厳密な質量行列ではない。曲線格子・特異解・非圧縮流体・Nek5000/nekRS本体は未実行。
limitations.en: One smooth fixed problem only. Meshes, quadrature and algebraic solvers differ: no speed, complexity or universal-accuracy ranking. The diagonal GLL quadrature mass is not the exactly integrated mass of every product. No curved mesh, singular solution, incompressible flow or Nek5000/nekRS run.

title.ja: スペクトル要素法の2D Poisson：P1 FEMとh/p収束を比較
title.en: 2D spectral-element Poisson: P1 FEM comparison and h/p refinement

summary.ja: 単位正方形の正弦製造解をGLLスペクトル要素法と既存P1三角形FEMで解きます。自由未知数を揃えたh細分化と、固定要素数でのp=1〜6を分けて測ります。
summary.en: Solve a sine manufactured solution on the unit square with GLL spectral elements and the existing triangle P1 FEM. Compare matched free-unknown counts under h refinement and p=1..6 at fixed elements.

assumptions.ja: 全て無次元。−Δu=2π²sin(πx)sin(πy)、領域[0,1]²、境界u=0。係数は一定、SEMは直交するアフィン正方形、FEMは既存の規則的な三角形分割。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless: -Laplacian u=2pi²sin(pi x)sin(pi y) on[0,1]², u=0 on the boundary. Constant coefficient; affine Cartesian squares for SEM and the existing regular triangle mesh for P1 FEM.

algorithm.ja: SEMはC0連続なテンソル積Qp Lagrange基底・p+1個のLegendre GLL節点と求積、疎な剛性行列・SciPy直接解法を使用。p=2で各方向2/4/8要素、別に2×2要素でp=1〜6。公開済みNumartのP1 FEM・GMRESをファイルのバイト列を保持して4/8/16分割で実行し、両者の自由未知数9/49/225を一致させます。
algorithm.en: C0 tensor Qp Lagrange SEM with p+1 Legendre GLL nodes/quadrature, sparse stiffness assembly and a SciPy direct solve. At p=2 use2/4/8 elements per axis; separately fix2x2 elements and p=1..6. Execute the byte-identical published Numart triangle P1 FEM/GMRES at4/8/16 subdivisions, matching9/49/225 free unknowns.

validation.ja: 解析的な正弦製造解と勾配を参照し、GLL節点とは異なる高次Gauss点で連続L2誤差・H1半ノルムを積分。h/p収束・自由未知数を揃えた誤差・境界値・真の残差を検査し、実際の2D場とP1の頂点・三角形・解をNPZに保存。
validation.en: Compare with the analytic manufactured sine solution/gradient. Integrate continuous L2/H1-seminorm errors at independent higher-order Gauss points. Check h/p refinement, matched-unknown errors, boundary data and true residuals; save actual2D SEM fields and P1 vertices/triangles/values in NPZ.

limits.ja: 滑らかな固定問題だけの結果。要素・求積・代数ソルバーが異なるので、速度・計算量・汎用的優位性の比較ではありません。GLLの対角求積質量は一般の積の厳密な質量行列ではない。曲線格子・特異解・非圧縮流体・Nek5000/nekRS本体は未実行。
limits.en: One smooth fixed problem only. Meshes, quadrature and algebraic solvers differ: no speed, complexity or universal-accuracy ranking. The diagonal GLL quadrature mass is not the exactly integrated mass of every product. No curved mesh, singular solution, incompressible flow or Nek5000/nekRS run.

formulas: -\Delta u=f,\quad u|_{\partial\Omega}=0,\quad u_*=\sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y),\quad f=2\pi^2u_*
